hook.name: ConfigurableKlikHook
hook.description: Configurable tax hook for token launches on Uniswap v4. Charges per-pool buy/sell taxes with optional launch-decay and volume-based surcharges (capped at 25%), splits fees among platform, hook creator, token creator, buyback, and holder rewards, and automatically purchases and burns tokens when the buyback budget reaches 0.1 ETH.
